units.translation: Or have you also heard the dream, so as to tell it correctly?
So as to draw a clot of blood in milk.
I judge him to be so as to hold together.
We will remain so, that someone may conjecture.
What of these things could you say so as to make clear to the mind?
Not so as (thus Porson for ὡς δ᾽) to help.
So as to release you entirely from these toils.
You prophesied so that the stranger should kill his mother.
Nor would I accept so as to have honors from you.
Apollo would not save you, so as not to go neglected.
Will you do this, so that I have such strength?
So as to make me young again in my aged mind.
Thus (the corrector: ὧδ᾽ first hand M) to see the end is present, what evil he accomplished.
In response to this, how the whole city of Susa laments the loss of men.
As I willingly speak to those who understand, and to those who do not understand I am forgotten.
